snapshot_next_report.first_output:
The hard disk manufacturers split wide open today: WDC up 5.6% and STX up 4.6%, while SNDK and MU both slipped. That's the most notable divergence on your watchlist — four names in the same storage theme moving in opposite directions without any obvious shared headline.

Your AI compute names moved together, gaining about 2% as a group. TSM, NVDA, and AVGO all rose in the 2.1–2.8% range, outpacing the semiconductor benchmark. AMD broke from the group, flat on the day, down 2.5 points versus its peers. Mega-cap tech also lifted: MSFT and GOOGL up around 2%, META and TSLA higher still. AAPL sat out the rally, down slightly while the rest of the theme gained. The power and infrastructure names you're tracking stayed quiet, except for CEG, which jumped 4.1% on its own.

Beyond your list, Brazilian fintech names made the most-actives screen — XP, PAGS, INTR, and STNE all up 20% or more — alongside NVAX, which rose 25%. PTC jumped 34%, the day's largest gain among high-volume names.

TSM reports in ten days, followed by TSLA and VRT six days after that. STX reports in twenty-two days, then a cluster hits in twenty-three: GEV and GOOGL.
